data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘mdl’, meaning ‘to fight’, Mandal is a powerful name evoking images of courage and strength. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the inner warrior striving for faith and righteousness, as well as the external battles fought in the path of Allah. The name Mandal carries the meaning “Brave warrior” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mandal usually hope their child will grow to embody brave warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
